metadata.heading_title: Suits by or against firms and persons carrying on business in names other than their own

heading.title: Suits by or against firms and persons carrying on business in names other than their own

article.title: No appearance except by partners.
article.content:
7No appearance except by partners.

Order 30, Rule 7
Where a summons is served in the manner provided by rule 3 upon a person having the control or management of the partnership business, no appearance by him shall be necessary unless he is a partner of the firm sued.
